component.name: HTTP REQUEST (SYSTEM, READ-ONLY)
component.description:
What it does Calls any HTTP API, webhook or service and hands the reply to the next step: the status code, whether it succeeded, the headers and the body, plus the body parsed from JSON when the server sent JSON.

How it works The request is built from the Inspector settings and the data arriving at the node, which may give the URL or a path under the Base URL, override the method, and add headers, query parameters and a body. It goes out through the organization's approved outbound routes, so the target host must have a route in Infrastructure > Networking. Redirects are not followed. An error status such as 404 or 500 is returned as a result with success false, so the orchestration can branch on it; a request that gets no response at all - a refused route, a timeout, a bad setting - fails the run.

Configure
- Method - GET (default), POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE or HEAD.
- Base URL - for example https://api.example.com/v1.
- Default Headers - a JSON object sent with every request.
- Authentication - none, bearer_token, api_key_header (with the API Key Header name) or basic_auth.
- Auth Token - bind the organization secret holding the token, key, or username:password.
- Timeout - seconds to wait, 30 by default.
- Response Type - auto (JSON when the server says so), json or text.
- Wait for Response - turn off to return only the status (webhook mode).

In and out In: optional url, method, headers, query_params, and a body (JSON) or body_text (raw text). Out: status_code, success, body (the text), data (the parsed JSON, an array as items), headers, content_type, elapsed_ms, and error when the status is 400 or above.

Use it when
- An orchestration needs data from, or must notify, an external API.
- An agent needs a tool it can call to reach a REST service.
- You want to fire a webhook at the end of a run.

component.manifest_yaml:
extension_type: tool
name: HTTP Request
description: >
  Makes one outbound HTTP request through the organization's approved routes
  and returns the status, headers and parsed body as data. An HTTP error
  status is returned with success false; a request that gets no response
  (bad configuration, refused route, timeout) fails the run.

input_ports:
  - port_name: input
    port_type: in
    # A TOOL reached by an INVOKE edge, or a step in a flow. The response is
    # data, not an artifact, so both halves are none.
    artifact_type_input: none
    artifact_type_output: none
    request_data:
      url: string (optional) - Absolute URL, or a path appended to Base URL.
      method: string (optional) - Overrides the Method parameter.
      headers: object (optional) - Headers added to (and overriding) the defaults.
      query_params: object (optional) - Query string parameters.
      body: object (optional) - JSON request body.
      body_text: string (optional) - Raw text request body, instead of body.
    response_data:
      status_code: integer - The HTTP status code.
      success: boolean - True when the status code is below 400.
      body: string - The response body as text; empty when Wait for Response is off.
      data: object - The body parsed as JSON (an array as items, a scalar as value); empty when not JSON.
      headers: object - The response headers.
      content_type: string - The response Content-Type; empty when the server sent none.
      elapsed_ms: integer - How long the request took, in milliseconds.
      error: string - "HTTP <code> <reason>" when success is false; empty otherwise.

required_secrets:
  - name: auth_token
    label: Auth Token
    required: false
    description: Bearer token, API key, or username:password for basic authentication.

input_parameters:
  - name: method
    type: select
    label: Method
    options: [GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD]
    default: GET
    required: true
  - name: base_url
    type: text
    label: Base URL
    description: For example https://api.example.com/v1. request_data.url may be a path under it.
  - name: default_headers
    type: text_long
    label: Default Headers (JSON)
    default: "{}"
    description: A JSON object of headers sent with every request.
  - name: auth_type
    type: select
    label: Authentication
    options: [none, bearer_token, api_key_header, basic_auth]
    default: none
  - name: auth_header_name
    type: text
    label: API Key Header
    default: X-API-Key
    description: The header that carries the key when Authentication is api_key_header.
  - name: timeout_seconds
    type: number
    label: Timeout (seconds)
    default: 30
  - name: response_type
    type: select
    label: Response Type
    options: [auto, json, text]
    default: auto
  - name: wait_for_response
    type: boolean
    label: Wait for Response
    default: true
    required: false
    description: When off, only the status is returned and the body is not read (webhook mode).

url.description: Absolute URL, or a path appended to Base URL.

headers.description: Headers added to (and overriding) the defaults.

body_text.description: Raw text request body, instead of body.

success.description: True when the status code is below 400.

body.description: The response body as text; empty when Wait for Response is off.

data.description: The body parsed as JSON (an array as items, a scalar as value); empty when not JSON.

content_type.description: The response Content-Type; empty when the server sent none.

elapsed_ms.description: How long the request took, in milliseconds.

error.description: "HTTP <code> <reason>" when success is false; empty otherwise.
